title: SQL Dumps in 4D v12
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: SQL EXPORT DATABASE and SQL EXPORT SELECTION commands
SQL EXECUTE SCRIPT command for re-importing SQL dumps

historical_commentary.text: The SQL EXPORT DATABASE/SELECTION and SQL EXECUTE SCRIPT commands documented here are still present and functional in current 4D, so this note's core technique remains a valid way to export and re-import SQL-format data dumps. It is a niche but still-useful capability, primarily relevant when interoperating with other SQL-based systems or performing bulk data migrations; day-to-day CRUD and reporting workflows in modern 4D projects would more commonly rely on ORDA rather than manual SQL dumps.
related_updates: ORDA entity selections and data-management APIs (introduced v16 R5/17+) are the modern default for day-to-day data access, while SQL dumps remain a viable niche tool for interoperability/migration
